variants.name: .17 HMR Blanks
variants.info:
Challenge Mode Unlocked!
Extremely low caliber blanks with pitiful performance, but better handling!
Good luck!

variants.name: 7.62x39 Blanks
variants.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with 7.62x39mm blank rounds! These being larger cartridges means you will propel your projectile further than 5.56x45mm, you also get greater ranges. However, there is the smaller magazine to tend to.

variants.name: 12.7x42mm Blanks
variants.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with custom 12.7x42mm blanks! Despite your small reserve pool, you get a large boost to your range potential with poorer velocity and close range performance.

variants.name: .223 Blanks
variants.info: Instead of regular 5.56x45mm blanks, load your AR-15 magazine with .223 Remington blank rounds! These being weaker cartridges will hurt your projecticles range performance, hurting velocity and damage ranges. But fret not! For you have a 50 round drum!
